2819ee1d9c240ab287c8bee8bc22a185.name: Cisbeacononanvil synth
2819ee1d9c240ab287c8bee8bc22a185.en: Twenty-two gliders build cis-beacon on anvil.
2819ee1d9c240ab287c8bee8bc22a185.pt: Vinte e dois planadores constroem o cis-beacon on anvil.

08b7d4d313b558aad1b9f251f64f92cb.name: Claw with tail synth
08b7d4d313b558aad1b9f251f64f92cb.en: Glider collisions that make a claw with tail.
08b7d4d313b558aad1b9f251f64f92cb.pt: Colisões de planadores que formam um claw with tail.

0fbd012141825dd94610679609bc8bc3.name: Cross synth
0fbd012141825dd94610679609bc8bc3.en: Sixteen gliders collide to form the cross oscillator.
0fbd012141825dd94610679609bc8bc3.pt: Dezesseis planadores colidem para formar o oscilador cross.

2386e2b1151de3b96e1a64027559a5dd.name: Diamond ring synth
2386e2b1151de3b96e1a64027559a5dd.en: Twenty-eight gliders build a variant of the diamond ring.
2386e2b1151de3b96e1a64027559a5dd.pt: Vinte e oito planadores constroem uma variante do diamond ring.

043e6a156228e68361bbff160e18d09d.name: Eater plug synth
043e6a156228e68361bbff160e18d09d.en: Gliders collide to assemble an eater plug.
043e6a156228e68361bbff160e18d09d.pt: Planadores colidem para montar um eater plug.

11e5bdc8273bfdf3b8e791655e91fabd.name: Eleven loop synth
11e5bdc8273bfdf3b8e791655e91fabd.en: Glider collisions that give rise to the eleven loop.
11e5bdc8273bfdf3b8e791655e91fabd.pt: Colisões de planadores que dão origem ao eleven loop.

2a1e78578e00f26dd29710c5856b0bc5.name: Fleet synth
2a1e78578e00f26dd29710c5856b0bc5.en: Gliders collide to create a fleet.
2a1e78578e00f26dd29710c5856b0bc5.pt: Planadores colidem para criar um fleet.

3acc8b4fe221e09f6ec0b3559315021b.name: Glasses synth
3acc8b4fe221e09f6ec0b3559315021b.en: Gliders collide to build the glasses oscillator.
3acc8b4fe221e09f6ec0b3559315021b.pt: Planadores colidem para construir o oscilador glasses.

03b2673f605e81b45a94171103da8c0e.name: Griddle and boat synth
03b2673f605e81b45a94171103da8c0e.en: Seventeen gliders assemble griddle and boat.
03b2673f605e81b45a94171103da8c0e.pt: Dezessete planadores montam o griddle and boat.

6f6dd7fadd6b24814abdaae65672998d.name: Heptapole synth
6f6dd7fadd6b24814abdaae65672998d.en: Gliders collide to form a heptapole.
6f6dd7fadd6b24814abdaae65672998d.pt: Planadores colidem para formar um heptapole.

2076c8fe1073a7500a919cad74f40a2b.name: House synth
2076c8fe1073a7500a919cad74f40a2b.en: Gliders collide to make a house; the same pattern is also listed as a pi-heptomino synthesis.
2076c8fe1073a7500a919cad74f40a2b.pt: Planadores colidem para formar um house; o mesmo padrão também aparece como síntese de pi-heptomino.

778d87bf34dfdb198e59e37969fc7a97.name: Iwona synth
778d87bf34dfdb198e59e37969fc7a97.pt: Planadores colidem para produzir o Iwona.

0e1d4fd0e2cb68d9b592f9fd38d069d9.name: Krake synth
0e1d4fd0e2cb68d9b592f9fd38d069d9.en: Just four gliders build a krake.
0e1d4fd0e2cb68d9b592f9fd38d069d9.pt: Apenas quatro planadores constroem um krake.

02414f0c1912973ff58fb2b0c6cf8800.name: Loafer synth
02414f0c1912973ff58fb2b0c6cf8800.en: Eight gliders build a loafer; this was derived from Adam Goucher's 18-glider synthesis, found just one day earlier.
02414f0c1912973ff58fb2b0c6cf8800.pt: Oito planadores constroem um loafer; esta síntese partiu da de 18 planadores de Adam Goucher, encontrada um dia antes.

008d972c690e1ce5a74682cdd6a2587e.name: Long long shillelagh synth
008d972c690e1ce5a74682cdd6a2587e.en: Gliders collide to create a long long shillelagh.
008d972c690e1ce5a74682cdd6a2587e.pt: Planadores colidem para criar um long long shillelagh.

096d262be6157fcfb1ad8a314808567a.name: Longclawwithtail synth
096d262be6157fcfb1ad8a314808567a.en: Four gliders suffice to make a long claw with tail.
096d262be6157fcfb1ad8a314808567a.pt: Quatro planadores bastam para formar um long claw with tail.

5a339a79afcd37e72fcf54f245dc2f47.name: Minipressurecooker synth
5a339a79afcd37e72fcf54f245dc2f47.en: Colliding gliders assemble the mini pressure cooker.
5a339a79afcd37e72fcf54f245dc2f47.pt: Planadores em colisão montam o mini pressure cooker.

126ea82492ef070f554b36a8b7ceecd3.name: Monogram synth
126ea82492ef070f554b36a8b7ceecd3.en: Gliders collide to build the monogram oscillator.
126ea82492ef070f554b36a8b7ceecd3.pt: Planadores colidem para construir o oscilador monogram.

8ad0bc983a02dcef9c6783e59a3c5bbc.name: Oddkeys synth
8ad0bc983a02dcef9c6783e59a3c5bbc.en: Gliders collide to form the odd keys oscillator.
8ad0bc983a02dcef9c6783e59a3c5bbc.pt: Planadores colidem para formar o oscilador odd keys.

0ae4f2cffccab8937db2dc77432a7c0c.name: P50 traffic jam synth
0ae4f2cffccab8937db2dc77432a7c0c.en: Thirty-four gliders assemble the P50 traffic jam.
0ae4f2cffccab8937db2dc77432a7c0c.pt: Trinta e quatro planadores montam o P50 traffic jam.

1fa75a07b49472c030e4c6fbdea3874b.name: Pennylane synth
1fa75a07b49472c030e4c6fbdea3874b.pt: Vinte e sete planadores constroem o penny lane.

0f68391da549f171ce2bca57bacb14e3.name: Period-184 glider gun synthesis
0f68391da549f171ce2bca57bacb14e3.en: Just 15 gliders collide to assemble a period-184 glider gun.
0f68391da549f171ce2bca57bacb14e3.pt: Apenas 15 planadores colidem para montar um canhão de planadores de período 184.

003fd78d8aceda4eb169ea460ef77816.name: Pond on pond synth
003fd78d8aceda4eb169ea460ef77816.en: Glider collisions that build a pond on pond.
003fd78d8aceda4eb169ea460ef77816.pt: Colisões de planadores que constroem um pond on pond.

4041a248b0f023c00cbb8d4c55518d4c.name: Pufferfishspaceshipsynth
4041a248b0f023c00cbb8d4c55518d4c.en: A glider synthesis that builds the pufferfish spaceship.
4041a248b0f023c00cbb8d4c55518d4c.pt: Uma síntese com planadores que constrói a nave pufferfish.

255fe5c47d76cf7205354e6458a229ad.name: R-bee and snake synth
255fe5c47d76cf7205354e6458a229ad.en: Seven gliders collide to make R-bee and snake.
255fe5c47d76cf7205354e6458a229ad.pt: Sete planadores colidem para formar o R-bee and snake.

19a3962001ce311e00bdcb9ba42b4720.name: Sesquihat synth
19a3962001ce311e00bdcb9ba42b4720.en: Glider collisions that produce a sesquihat.
19a3962001ce311e00bdcb9ba42b4720.pt: Colisões de planadores que produzem um sesquihat.

37bbab0bd0b14ac961435c50a9a03682.name: Sidecar synth
37bbab0bd0b14ac961435c50a9a03682.en: Gliders collide to build a sidecar.
37bbab0bd0b14ac961435c50a9a03682.pt: Planadores colidem para construir um sidecar.

1afa7a888b79a0e58f3c80b7ecb2693d.name: Snacker synth
1afa7a888b79a0e58f3c80b7ecb2693d.en: Gliders collide to assemble a snacker.
1afa7a888b79a0e58f3c80b7ecb2693d.pt: Planadores colidem para montar um snacker.

11a86e599dca5cf893d1feb8730779f4.name: Snorkel loop synth
11a86e599dca5cf893d1feb8730779f4.en: Six gliders build a snorkel loop.
11a86e599dca5cf893d1feb8730779f4.pt: Seis planadores constroem um snorkel loop.

093af953309ec4e8011a8e0a8c54c0e5.name: tannersp46 synth
093af953309ec4e8011a8e0a8c54c0e5.en: Nineteen gliders collide to assemble Tanner's p46.
093af953309ec4e8011a8e0a8c54c0e5.pt: Dezenove planadores colidem para montar o Tanner's p46.

61ac2889994327ec47aafd98f61be37f.name: Toadsynth
61ac2889994327ec47aafd98f61be37f.en: Gliders collide to form the toad oscillator.
61ac2889994327ec47aafd98f61be37f.pt: Planadores colidem para formar o oscilador toad.

06565d0181dcbbbfcde5f220df5ddad2.name: Trans-boat with tail synth
06565d0181dcbbbfcde5f220df5ddad2.en: Glider collisions that make a trans-boat with tail.
06565d0181dcbbbfcde5f220df5ddad2.pt: Colisões de planadores que formam um trans-boat with tail.

01ba818ad6f789ac5c00bc82e2dc8768.name: Tub synth
01ba818ad6f789ac5c00bc82e2dc8768.en: Gliders collide to create a tub.
01ba818ad6f789ac5c00bc82e2dc8768.pt: Planadores colidem para criar um tub.

00acd40b8ffe1a40e87304443012483a.name: Twinhat synth
00acd40b8ffe1a40e87304443012483a.en: Several glider syntheses of twin hat: a 4-glider one plus others taken from Mark Niemiec's database.
00acd40b8ffe1a40e87304443012483a.pt: Várias sínteses do twin hat com planadores: uma de 4 planadores e outras tiradas do banco de dados de Mark Niemiec.

3472f4db624499d6a61cad3e9f02da38.name: Twotransgriddleswithtwotubs synth
3472f4db624499d6a61cad3e9f02da38.en: Nine gliders collide to build a pair of trans griddles together with two tubs.
3472f4db624499d6a61cad3e9f02da38.pt: Nove planadores colidem para montar o two trans griddles with two tubs.

051b880b60a193401612df1e02e04886.name: Verylongshillelagh synth
051b880b60a193401612df1e02e04886.en: Only four gliders are needed for a very long shillelagh.
051b880b60a193401612df1e02e04886.pt: Bastam quatro planadores para formar um very long shillelagh.

0be5cc01d7e3ec24ac39c509f04f0094.name: 104P177 reactions
0be5cc01d7e3ec24ac39c509f04f0094.en: A collection of reactions in which a glider interacts with Karel's p177.
0be5cc01d7e3ec24ac39c509f04f0094.pt: Uma coleção de reações em que um planador interage com o Karel's p177.

08be64d2a84b36b7eb6ba1e7bd230bec.name: Deep cell
08be64d2a84b36b7eb6ba1e7bd230bec.en: Double-duty unit Life cell: it hosts a pair of Life universes simultaneously.
08be64d2a84b36b7eb6ba1e7bd230bec.pt: Célula unitária que trabalha em dobro: abriga ao mesmo tempo dois universos do Jogo da Vida.

c85c1cb70213bea4bde231e78c4ae8d3.name: Infinite LWSS hotel
c85c1cb70213bea4bde231e78c4ae8d3.en: The lightweight-spaceship counterpart of the infinite glider hotel.
c85c1cb70213bea4bde231e78c4ae8d3.pt: A versão para naves leves do infinite glider hotel.

2545294e09225d422fb4c06365f1789e.name: Mosquito 4
2545294e09225d422fb4c06365f1789e.en: Only 73 cells, yet it grows quadratically over time.
2545294e09225d422fb4c06365f1789e.pt: Apenas 73 células, mas com crescimento quadrático ao longo do tempo.

6f913eb02d76d4ba28f013a748535639.name: Period 11 - 14 oscillators
6f913eb02d76d4ba28f013a748535639.en: A catalogue of oscillators with periods from 11 through 14.
6f913eb02d76d4ba28f013a748535639.pt: Um catálogo de osciladores com períodos de 11 a 14.

04ffd5f5047f4eb0e4dc08dc13091432.name: t^1.5
04ffd5f5047f4eb0e4dc08dc13091432.en: Its population grows like t to the power 1.5: at generation t it approaches t^(3/2) divided by the square root of 9720.
04ffd5f5047f4eb0e4dc08dc13091432.pt: A população cresce como t elevado a 1,5: na geração t ela se aproxima de t^(3/2) dividido pela raiz quadrada de 9720.

257b9fa8c3261a71f54a2837f2f75339.name: Blinker pull
257b9fa8c3261a71f54a2837f2f75339.en: A glider hits a blinker and drags it back toward where the glider came from, shifting it by (-1, 3).
257b9fa8c3261a71f54a2837f2f75339.pt: Um planador atinge um pisca-pisca e o puxa na direção de onde o planador veio, deslocando-o em (-1, 3).

16ed933d61e3e5c025b729c56ca0b2e4.name: Cap
16ed933d61e3e5c025b729c56ca0b2e4.en: An induction coil that is easy to stabilize into a period-3 oscillator; the candelabra is a close variation.
16ed933d61e3e5c025b729c56ca0b2e4.pt: Uma bobina de indução fácil de estabilizar num oscilador de período 3; o candelabra é uma pequena variação dela.

00163e4b978c4f6d78b5611077722e23.name: Crystal
00163e4b978c4f6d78b5611077722e23.en: Orderly growth built from debris by a glider stream; this glider-block crash starts the common kind, which gains two beehives per 11 gliders if the stream has even period 82 or more.
00163e4b978c4f6d78b5611077722e23.pt: Crescimento ordenado que um fluxo de planadores gera a partir de detritos; esta colisão planador-bloco inicia o tipo comum, que ganha duas colmeias a cada 11 planadores se o fluxo tiver período par de 82 ou mais.

50c4bfb2afcf1ad938c89c6282d4dad7.name: Garden of Eden 5
50c4bfb2afcf1ad938c89c6282d4dad7.en: Held the size record among Gardens of Eden until Garden of Eden 6 overtook it in December 2011; left alone, it dies out after 19 generations.
50c4bfb2afcf1ad938c89c6282d4dad7.pt: Foi o menor Jardim do Éden (Garden of Eden) conhecido até o Garden of Eden 6 superá-lo em dezembro de 2011; sozinho, some após 19 gerações.

110150f237cb497bc0d9307e0ea2fe0f.name: Hook
110150f237cb497bc0d9307e0ea2fe0f.en: Also called pre-pre-block: it turns into a pre-block and then a block. Two gliders form it easily, and a glider hitting it can produce an MWSS.
110150f237cb497bc0d9307e0ea2fe0f.pt: Também chamado pre-pre-block: vira um pre-block e depois um bloco. Dois planadores o formam com facilidade, e um planador que o atinja pode gerar uma nave média.

03b34f2a2dda055c0314941e45cd82b7.name: Log(t)^2 growth
03b34f2a2dda055c0314941e45cd82b7.en: Grows forever, but extremely slowly: its growth is on the order of log(t) squared.
03b34f2a2dda055c0314941e45cd82b7.pt: Cresce para sempre, mas bem devagar: o crescimento é da ordem de log(t) ao quadrado.

1c833ed51d77fb420070200d6d1d8314.name: Phi
1c833ed51d77fb420070200d6d1d8314.en: A common spark named for the phi-like shape it takes one generation later; Tanner's p46 produces it, and the pentadecathlon makes a slightly flawed version.
1c833ed51d77fb420070200d6d1d8314.pt: Uma faísca comum, batizada pela forma de fi que assume uma geração depois; o Tanner's p46 a produz, e o pentadecathlon gera uma versão levemente imperfeita.

2f1d25d52e3c82c384bfb4f43d6ea704.name: Q-pentomino
2f1d25d52e3c82c384bfb4f43d6ea704.en: The name Conway gave to one of the 12 pentominoes; after 9 generations it becomes a traffic light.
2f1d25d52e3c82c384bfb4f43d6ea704.pt: Nome dado por Conway a um dos 12 pentominós; após 9 gerações ele vira um traffic light.

5c7de94219c13081674dd8e88e86d3cf.name: Stairstep hexomino
5c7de94219c13081674dd8e88e86d3cf.en: One of the 35 hexominoes; after 63 generations it settles into the blockade.
5c7de94219c13081674dd8e88e86d3cf.pt: Um dos 35 hexominós; após 63 gerações se estabiliza no blockade.

b046f6fba573b26baf788e88b62f6778.name: Teardrop
b046f6fba573b26baf788e88b62f6778.en: An induction coil that turns into a pair of beehives after 20 generations; in the butterfly the two beehives end up five cells farther apart.
b046f6fba573b26baf788e88b62f6778.pt: Uma bobina de indução que vira um par de colmeias após 20 gerações; no butterfly, as duas colmeias ficam cinco células mais afastadas.

2e7ca014bff4563e39afe6e8ca08b3c5.name: tubstretcherc124b
2e7ca014bff4563e39afe6e8ca08b3c5.en: A pseudo tub-stretcher by Jason Summers that advances at c/124.
2e7ca014bff4563e39afe6e8ca08b3c5.pt: Um pseudo tub-stretcher de Jason Summers que avança a c/124.

04925cf9575784de0e47248f12277ef5.name: Waveguide 1
04925cf9575784de0e47248f12277ef5.pt: O primeiro waveguide (guia de onda) já descoberto.
